|lead='''Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe''' is a [[Dark]] [[Objective]] distributed as a double-sided 5×7-inch box topper in [[Reflections]] displays.<ref name="encyclopedia" /> It reprints the art and game text from [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Special Edition]] and keeps its expansion symbol.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Complete Card List v4.0], entry N4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261119013811/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="printed-faces">Phoenix Cards, [[:File:Reflections oversized box toppers Phoenix 5810 original.jpg|0 side]] and [[:File:Reflections oversized box toppers Phoenix 5811 original.jpg|7 side]] of the oversized Hunt Down and Destroy the Jedi objective.</ref>
|game_text='''0 side — Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi'''

Deploy Holotheatre and Visage Of The Emperor. May deploy Meditation Chamber and/or Epic Duel. {While} this side up, during your move phase, may use 4 Force to take Vader into hand from a location you control (cards on him go to owner's Used Pile). Add 4 to each player's destiny draw for Sense and Alter. {Flip} this card if Vader is at a battleground site and no Light Jedi or Luke is at a battleground site. {Place} out of play if you play Scanning Crew, initiate a non-Epic duel or Force drain at an Executor site.

'''7 side — Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe'''

{While} this side up, opponent cannot initiate battles or Force drains where opponent has a Jedi or Skywalker. You lose no Force from Visage Of The Emperor. While Vader at Meditation Chamber, subtract 2 from each of opponent's battle destiny draws. Opponent may not play Sense or Alter. {Flip} this card if opponent has Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site or if Vader is not on table. {Place} out of play if you play Scanning Crew, initiate a non-Epic duel or Force drain at an Executor site.<ref name="printed-faces" />
|rulings=* The Players Committee Tournament Guide allows this oversized Objective in a tournament deck and counts it as a card in that deck.<ref name="tournament-guide">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Star-Wars-CCG-Tournament-Guide-2.2.pdf#page=7 Star Wars CCG Tournament Guide 2.2], §2.10. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021115743/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Star-Wars-CCG-Tournament-Guide-2.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
